name: Monkeys WhatsApp Assistant
install: if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; else echo "Bootstrap repository - dependencies will be installed after project initialization"; fi

terminals.name: assistant-server
terminals.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm start; else echo "Bootstrap repository - no package.json yet, skipping start"; exec sleep infinity; fi
